title: Layered dividing CIPS condensates at a lower start amplitude (noise 0.02): 2 nucleations, then division alone fills the box, to generation 4
summary: c40's layered dividing CIPS world with only the random-field amplitude lowered from 0.03 to 0.02 (world.py). On seed 0 just 2 condensates nucleate (the uniform state is linearly stable, so nucleation needs a large enough local excess), and the rest of the box is populated by repeated dumbbell pinching: 11 persistent splits, 0 merges, max generation 4 by t=20000, 14 bodies and still an empty region left (sheet, lineage). At noise 0.015 nothing nucleates on seed 0 in 20000 t. A 3-seed pack to t=25000 is running.
